name: legion
description: Deterministic safety kernel (bin/legion.mjs) + skills/agents/hooks for one-Claude-Code-session-per-feature orchestration

consult_backend.title: Consult backend
consult_backend.description: codex | gemini (CLIs) — openai | google | xai | deepseek | mistral (hosted APIs) — api (custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

consult_model.title: Consult model
consult_model.description: Model name. Optional for codex/gemini (empty = the CLI's own default), REQUIRED for API backends

consult_base_url.title: Consult API base URL
consult_base_url.description: backend=api: required OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Named providers: optional override

consult_token_env.title: Consult token env var
consult_token_env.description: NAME of the env var holding the API token (the value stays in your shell env). backend=api: required. Named providers: optional override
